storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/finrashortvolotc/, one file per TRADE date (gz after 2 days)
written_by: server/finraShortVolume.ts archiveOrfShortVolDay (6h poll, 10-day lookback newest-first, eager boot)
source: FINRA Reg SHO daily short sale volume, ORF (Over-the-Counter Reporting Facility) file (cdn.finra.org/equity/regsho/daily/FORFshvol{YYYYMMDD}.txt) — keyless; ~3-4K OTC symbols/trading day; weekend/holiday URLs 403 = not published (valid). Same schema as finrashortvol's CNMS file (parseShortVol handles both); verified live 2026-07-27
license: FINRA publishes these files for free use with attribution; attribution 'FINRA Reg SHO daily short sale volume'
attribution: FINRA Reg SHO daily short sale volume (ORF/OTC facility)

field_map.date (trade date) — file-level dedup key: same convention as finrashortvol: the ORF file is atomic and final once published; dedup is DATE-level
field_map.symbol/market: as published (market = "O" for this facility, observed live)
field_map.trailer integrity: same bare row-count trailer check as CNMS — truncated downloads never reach the archive

confidence_model: RAW official venue data (ORF short-marked volume for non-exchange-listed OTC equities). NOT total short interest. Built specifically to fix server/settlementStress.ts's composite: finrathreshold (the threshold-persistence ingredient) is OTC-only by FINRA's own schema, and finrashortvol's CNMS file is exchange-listed-only — the two are disjoint populations, so the composite's 3-way join found zero overlap since it shipped until this stream was added. See settlementStress.ts's 2026-07-27 module-doc note and experiments.md for the full root-cause trace.
cadence: daily trading-day file, published evenings ET; 6h poll makes off-hours a dedup no-op
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Deliberately no deep-backfill path yet (same conservative default-off posture finrashortvol's CNMS backfill only added as a later, separate PR, per its own 2026-07-05 emergency-off volume-fill incident) — filed as a NEXT step, not built here.
